Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 3-H at 1856 to 1858 W
                              Chicago Ave - App No. 22083T1
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                          ORDINANCE

       BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

       SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
is hereby amended by changmg all of the B3-2 Community Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 3-H in the area bounded by

              the alley next north of West Cliicago Avenue; a line 50.00 feet east
              of and parallel to North Wolcott Avenue; West Chicago Avenue;
              and North Wolcott Avenue

        to those of a B3-3 Community Shopping District and a corresponding use district is hereby
established in the area above described.

       SECTION2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


       Address;       1856 to 1858 West Chicago Avenue, Chicago, Illinois

SUBJECT PROPERTY: 1856 TO 1858 WEST CHICAGO AVENUE, CHICAGO, ILLINOIS

LOT AREA: 5,880 SQUARE FEET

LAND USE: THE PROPERTY IS CURRENTLY IMPROVED WITH A FOUR-STORY, MIXED
BUILDING WITH TWO COMMERCIAL SPACES AND TWELVE RESIDENTIAL UNITS, TEN OF

BUILDING SIZE AND UNIT CONFIGURATION INTO COMPLIANCE BY r.EGALIZING THE TWO
NON-CONFORMING RESIDENTIAL UNITS. NO CHANGES TO THE ENVELOPE OF THE

(B)   MINIMUM LOT AREA: 490 SQUARE, FEET PER DWELLING UNIT

(C)   THE AMOUNT OF OFF-STREET PARKING; 6. APPLICANT IS SEEKING A PARKING
      REDUCTION BASED ON ITS STANDING AS A TRANSIT SERVED LOCATION

(D)   SETBACKS:

      1.    FRONT SETBACK: 0 FEET, 0 INCHES (EXISTING)

      2.    REAR SETBACK: 38 FEET, I INCH (EXISTING)

      3.    SIDE SETBACKS: 0 FEET, 0 INCHES (SOUTH) AND 0 FEET, 0 INCHES (NORTH)
      (EXISTING).

D.    BUILDING HEIGHT: 49 FEET, 3 INCHES (EXISTING)

E.    THE NUMBER OF OFF-STREET LOADING BERTHS: 0.
